name: mastervault-mcp-server
description: A headless, filesystem-backed MCP server that serves any MasterVault — its files and its operating protocol — to any MCP client. No Obsidian required.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm test
scripts.build:bundled: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=dist-bundled/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __mvCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __mvCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"

author: JustMichael-80 (ChronoDyne Systems, Inc.)
